provider_notes: Mock supports authored key-value fixtures and narrow add-workstation/rename prompts only. Natural-language technical specs and all broader follow-ups require an explicitly selected live provider. Review every change set before accepting. Ordinary edits and exports use no model calls.

prompts.prompt: Rename Trial integration gateway to Trial telemetry gateway
prompts.expected: Preview a rename only. Keep production-handoff and cloud-telemetry interface IDs and routes.

prompts.prompt: Add a second Trial robot in Testbed Client with its own MQTT over TLS TCP 8883 session to Robot controller through Trial virtual firewall. Keep production and AWS unchanged.
prompts.expected: New physical robot, Testbed Client deployment and bounded interface only; no production-zone reassignment.

prompts.prompt: Set telemetry retention to 7 days for this trial. Do not change which payloads may leave the testbed.
prompts.expected: Update the named retention constraint/decision; keep the production-data and personal-data exclusions.

prompts.prompt: Make Trial virtual firewall a pair of active-passive instances, hosted on Trial compute host. Keep all placements and routes.
prompts.expected: Review explicit quantity 2 and active_passive deployment metadata. A shared host is still a common failure point; do not claim full resilience.

prompts.prompt: Remove the proposed production status handoff for the trial, leaving the AWS telemetry path unchanged.
prompts.expected: Preview removal of production-handoff only and review before accepting; no component or cloud interface deletion.
